programs.desc: Nim is running a bit late but eventually gets around to baking marvellous mango emoji faces, making a seagull costume and creating a fabulous \.

programs.desc: Rangers Justine and Kaeng go on an adventure to explore the amazing animals of the rainforest! They use binoculars to spot animals hiding high in the trees, paint colourful butterflies, and dress up like a cassowary!

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Simon finds Bok in the Wiggly Kitchen; he loves to play 'Simon Says' - join in and play along too! Simon is worried about Bok as he is very quiet, will the 'Wiggle Groove' help Bok get his groove back?

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds meet the penguins! See them snuggle, waddle, nap, and slide. From gentoo to king penguins, it's a chilly, splashy, fishy adventure full of fun.

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: One morning at breakfast, Baby Bun wants more Crispy Crunchies cereal. But uh-oh, the box is empty.

programs.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes have to tread ever so lightly if they want to retrieve their ball from a cluster of sleeping Cucumberdiles - but keeping a low profile is not in a Pea-Rexes nature.

programs.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programs.desc: Andy travels back in time 3 million years to the Great Rift Valley in Africa to meet one of our very own ancient ancestors, Australopithecus. During his adventure he has a narrow escape from an angry relative of the elephant.

programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: Preston's stuck in a balloon and only Mojo and Bo can get him back on the ground.
